name: raff-library
description: رَفّ 4.0.0 — الجيل الجديد من نظام إدارة وفهرسة المكتبات بواجهة فائقة الحداثة ومحرك Rust + Tauri 2 + SQLite
author: Hzifa33

scripts.dist:win: npm run dist:win:x64 && npm run dist:win:x86
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.dist:win:x86: npm run build && tauri build --target i686-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && tauri build --bundles dmg,app
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:rust && npm run test:v4
